title: Aqara Leak Sensor Check-In Gap
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=aqara:device device_class=leak
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by device
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Uses Aqara leak-sensor telemetry telemetry to monitor time since each leak sensor last checked in in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for silent water sensors before they matter, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Aqara leak-sensor telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Leak-sensor table ranked by hours since last update.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces time since each leak sensor last checked in so you can spot silent water sensors before they matter before it becomes annoying.
